CR-1.title: COMMIT between NEWLEADER and UPTODATE dereferences an empty packetsNotCommitted (NPE)
CR-1.cause: The update clears packetsNotCommitted at NEWLEADER; the COMMIT branch dereferences packetsNotCommitted.peekFirst() without a null check.

CR-2.title: Request processors started at NEWLEADER are not shut down when synchronization fails before UPTODATE
CR-2.cause: startupWithoutServing starts the processors but leaves state INITIAL; LearnerZooKeeperServer.shutdown returns early because canShutdown() is false.

CR-3.title: A SyncThread per-txn ACK can overtake the NEWLEADER ACK
CR-3.cause: The update starts SyncRequestProcessor/SendAckRequestProcessor and hands off txns before the learner thread writes the NEWLEADER ACK; LearnerHandler treats the first ACK after NEWLEADER as the NEWLEADER ACK.

MC-1.title: NEWLEADER ACK is sent before the DIFF-synchronized history is durable
MC-1.cause: Learner.syncWithLeader hands buffered proposals to FollowerZooKeeperServer.logRequest, which only enqueues to SyncRequestProcessor, and writes the NEWLEADER ACK without waiting for append/fsync; currentEpoch is already persisted.
